text.tspan: Be your own CA: who makes which key, and what the CA signs
Oct 14 → Oct 21 2026 in the tested run
A client checks: who issued it (issuer) · when it's valid (notBefore / notAfter) · which names it covers (the SAN, not the CN).
Without -copy_extensions copy the certificate has no SAN, and every name check fails.
